title: Bell as a thorium-mercury overunity power device

tellings.quote: So so it was a overunity device where you would be putting a certain amount of energy into it both AC and DC but then the nuclear reaction of the thorium

plain: The Bell, a device said to have been built by Nazi Germany at the Skoda Works near Prague between 1937 and 1944, is described as an "overunity" machine, one that gives out more energy than goes into it. AC and DC power went in, and a nuclear reaction of thorium and mercury did the rest. The researcher Jason Jorjani says an unnamed elderly man in Serbia told him this. If true, the Nazis built a power source that broke the normal limits of physics.
